items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: So Sidney Adrian and I would play together.

ctx.x: How did Buddy Petit play? Buddy Petit played the semi, just like Bunk.

I couldn't tell the difference between him and Buddy, him and Bunk. Buddy Petit was the corner player that really knocked me out. He really, he really, none of our comments playing like between Buddy and Bunk. Buddy Petit was the corner player that had a great big tune and a beautiful soul. And he played with a great drive. He didn't play many high notes, but he didn't need to make no high notes. The way that guy played in the scales was everything. He played with really, he didn't need to make no high notes. So…
You want to rest a minute?
